3139-5330-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-5330-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-5330-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Atog by sacrificing The Great Henge, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.

575-728-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-728-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 6.

2021-2060-6627-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2021-2060-6627-7803.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.

1651-1770-2573-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.

Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.

Play the land from your graveyard.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

225-565-1987-2239.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.

Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing land.

When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Ardent Elementalist.
When the land and Ardent Elementalist enter the battlefield, Ardent Elementalist and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-2239.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

1571-2154-5728-5929.description:

Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Leyline of Transformation, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Misthollow Griffin token, adding {R}.
Cast Misthollow Griffin from exile by paying {2}{U}{U}.

Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Bloodwater Entity.

Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.

Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Livio.

Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.
